about: What's New feed shown in the game (modules/news.js). Newest first is not required: the game sorts by date + version. Fields: id (unique), date YYYY-MM-DD, version, title, items[], big (highlighted card), image (optional, relative path like assets/ui/news/x.jpg). Written by the release manager (qa/release) when a big feature goes live.

entries.title: Game modes: Team Deathmatch and Demolition
items: Team Deathmatch: two teams, first to the kill target wins
Demolition: plant the charge at site A or B, or defuse it, round by round
Free for all stays the classic mode
Already playing? Refresh the page with Ctrl+F5 to get the new modes

entries.title: Sharper graphics
items: Smoother edges and sharper detail
Richer colours and better shading on every map
Four quality levels, picked for your graphics card automatically

entries.title: Full settings menu
items: New Settings screen (main menu and pause menu): gameplay, controls, mouse, crosshair, video and audio
Re-bind any key, separate aim-down-sights mouse speed, invert Y
Build your own crosshair with a live preview and share it with a code
Field of view, brightness, camera shake and colour-blind enemy colours
Separate volume for effects and ambience, louder enemy footsteps option

entries.title: Ceiling bump fix
items: Jumping into a low ceiling no longer throws you out of the room (Temple summit room and every other low ceiling)

entries.title: Our own game server and public rooms
items: Sector Nine now runs on its own game server: a public room list, rooms for 3 to 8 players, the host role moves on if the host leaves, and you reconnect if your connection drops
Smooth movement even when the connection lags, like pro shooters do it
Real ping shown on the scoreboard (Tab)
You can hear enemy footsteps
Pausing is silent everywhere
Editing a room keeps the same invite link
Higher jump

entries.title: Sharper hits and a better killcam
items: Bullets hit exactly what you see, on every map
Killcam shows your killer's real aim: sights, sniper scope, movement and reloads
Bodies fall to the ground when killed in mid-air
Calmer lighting on Temple, Glacier and Shrine

entries.title: All 10 maps rebuilt
items: Every map rebuilt from scratch, each with its own layout, size and landmarks
Wallbangs: shoot through thin walls, pods and crates (damage depends on thickness)
No more freezes in the middle of a match
